dogecoin.text:
@yackRuby @Mepslol Dogecoin's market cap (and Cardano being at #3 right now) should give you some pause when considering the application of efficient market hypothesis to crypto. 

Lots of irrationality.
@Mattanite My guess is that most of the retail money went to dogecoin, safemoon, etc, so "classic retail fomo blowoff parabola" happened there instead of Bitcoin

@HYFRitsJimmy @INArteCarloDoss Also, more alts and random ponzis + the popularity of Eth = less money going towards Bitcoin. The dumb retail money that would have pumped BTC the last 40% to its expected 100k+ peak went to Eth, dogecoin, safemoon instead
